answer_4.quote: To learn the expected behavior of any models, we conduct a human studies on CRIPP-VQA dataset. There were total 6 people participated as volunteers. All were given 5 videos and corresponding QA pairs to get habituated with the environment. Then we asked them to answer total 30 questions on different set of randomly selected videos.
